prior_provenance.rpe1_kernel: RPE1 NTC-centred pseudobulk (paper App. A.1) -> TARGET-INTERNAL for an RPE1 target: MUST BE EXCLUDED
prior_provenance.k562_kernel: K562 NTC-centred pseudobulk -> the external transfer prior for RPE1; NOT published, must be built locally from the local K562 data
prior_provenance.pops_kernel: public scRNA atlas (PoPS) gene embeddings - cell-line independent
prior_provenance.esm_kernel: ESM protein-LM gene embeddings - cell-line independent
prior_provenance.biogpt_kernel: BioGPT literature gene embeddings - cell-line independent
prior_provenance.node2vec_kernel: PPI network node2vec embeddings - cell-line independent
prior_provenance.ops_*_kernel: optical pooled screen CellProfiler perturbation embeddings - different assays/cell lines
prior_provenance.ground_truth_delta: the target response kernel itself (RPE1) - scorer/upper-bound only, never a prior

leakage_rule: exclude rpe1_kernel for an RPE1 target
ground_truth_delta never enters any policy observation
K562-derived priors are allowed (external, different cell line)
